description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'reqCommands' class, which manages requirements within a test management system. It includes methods for creating, editing, deleting, copying, reordering requirements, managing versioning, relations, test cases, attachments, and monitoring features. The class interacts with other components such as requirement managers, configuration, and logging systems to perform comprehensive requirement management operations.

classes.name: reqCommands
classes.description: This class manages requirement operations including creation, editing, deletion, version control, relations, test case management, attachments, and monitoring within the TestLink project.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes a GUI data object with default properties for requirement management interface.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new requirement based on provided arguments and request data.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing an existing requirement.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation process of a new requirement including database insertion and UI setup.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Processes updates to an existing requirement, managing versioning and attribute changes.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a requirement, handling cascade deletions and related cleanup.

methods.name: doUnfreezeVersion
methods.description: Reopens a frozen requirement version.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Initiates requirement reordering process within a requirement specification.

methods.name: doReorder
methods.description: Executes the reordering of requirements in a specified order.

methods.name: createTestCases
methods.description: Prepares a GUI for creating test cases from requirements.

methods.name: doCreateTestCases
methods.description: Creates test cases from selected requirements and updates the GUI accordingly.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Prepares data for copying a requirement to another location.

methods.name: doCopy
methods.description: Performs the copying of a requirement to another location, including logging and UI updates.

methods.name: doCreateVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing requirement.

methods.name: doDeleteVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of a requirement.

methods.name: doAddRelation
methods.description: Adds a relation between two requirements.

methods.name: doDeleteRelation
methods.description: Removes a relation between requirements.

methods.name: doCreateRevision
methods.description: Creates a new revision of a requirement.

methods.name: doFreezeVersion
methods.description: Freezes a requirement version to prevent further changes.

methods.name: addTestCase
methods.description: Associates an external test case with a requirement.

methods.name: removeTestCase
methods.description: Removes association of a test case from a requirement.

methods.name: fileUpload
methods.description: Handles file upload for attachments linked to requirements.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes an attachment linked to a requirement.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops monitoring a requirement for changes or updates.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring a requirement for changes or updates.
